SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section I, Special Branch.
REPORT
File No. 957
8/9/64/ 12 24
Date December 6, 1939.

Subject V.B. LISAMER.

Made by D. F.S. Killingbeck. Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

With reference to the attached enquiry
regarding a person named LESONER or LESONAR, the
only record on file at Police Headquarters is of
the departure of a Miss A.L. LESOIER, on October
8, 1939, per the S.S. "SHANGHAI MARU".

No person named LESONER or LESONAR
is known at the addresses mentioned, but from
enquiries made it would appear that this person
is identical with one V.B. LISAMER.(B.A.C.L)

Mr. V.B. LISAMER arrived in Shanghai
on August 31, 1939, on board the S.S."Wing Sang"
and took up residence at the Cathay Hotel, where
he stated that he had come from Singapore. He
left the Cathay on September 10 and booked
accommodation at the Park Hotel. On November 4,
1939, he was asked by the management to vacate his
room, as he was unable to meet his liabilities
regularly. He is believed to have told people
at the Park Hotel that he is an ex-Police official,
in receipt of a pension, mentioning that he had
reached the rank of Chief Inspector. This state-
ment was received with some doubt, as Lisamer
apparently does not appear to be possessed of any
great amount of intelligence. He is still under
financial obligation to the management of the Park
Hotel, but the amount is gradually being repaid,
an arrangement to this effect having been made
between the parties concerned and a bank in the

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科（Special Branch）第一股。
报告
档案号 957
8/9/64/ 12 24
日期：1939年12月6日。

事由：V.B. LISAMER。

制作人：D. F.S. Killingbeck。转呈人：D. I. Crawford。

关于所附针对一名名为 LESONER 或 LESONAR 之人的查询，警察总局档案中唯一的记录是 A.L. LESOIER 小姐于1939年10月8日乘坐“上海丸”号（S.S. "SHANGHAI MARU"）离境。

在上述地址未查得名为 LESONER 或 LESONAR 之人，但经查询，此人似乎与 V.B. LISAMER（B.A.C.L）为同一人。

V.B. LISAMER 先生于1939年8月31日乘坐“永盛”号（S.S. "Wing Sang"）抵达上海，入住华懋饭店（Cathay Hotel），并称其来自新加坡。他于9月10日离开华懋饭店，并在国际饭店（Park Hotel）预订了住宿。1939年11月4日，因无法定期清偿债务，饭店管理层要求其腾退房间。据信，他曾向国际饭店的人员表示自己是退休警务官员，领取养老金，并提及自己曾升至总巡长（Chief Inspector）职级。此说法受到一定质疑，因为 Lisamer 看起来并不具备很高的智力水平。他仍欠国际饭店管理层债务，但正在逐步偿还，相关方已与当地一家银行就此达成安排，

town. Lisamer appeared to receive money at certain
intervals which seems to support his statement that
he is obtaining some pension, or other periodical
stipend.

During his stay in the Cathay and Park
Hotels, Lissmer did not receive any callers and
very seldom went out. He is stated to have spent
a great portion of his time in the bars of these
two hotels, and his only acquaintances appeared
to be people he met in the bar with whom he would
exchange the usual courtesies. As far as can be
ascertained, he has not been conducting any business
since coming to Shanghai.

At the present time, Lisamer is living at
the New Asia Hotel in Shanghai and is reported to
have informed the management of that hotel that he
will be leaving for Tokyo some time during January.

Enquiries have failed to reveal any
instance in which he has used the name LESONER or
LESONAR and it is not known whether LESONER and
LISAMER are, in fact, the same person.

(批：C. G. 1/9)

J. Killingback
D. P. S.

D. C. ( Special Branch ).

Lisamer 似乎每隔一段时间就会收到款项，这似乎佐证了他关于领取养老金或其他定期津贴的说法。

在入住华懋饭店和国际饭店期间，Lissmer 未接待任何访客，也极少外出。据说他将大部分时间花在这两家饭店的酒吧里，他唯一的熟人似乎是在酒吧结识的人，彼此仅进行一般的礼节性寒暄。据查，自抵沪以来，他并未从事任何商业活动。

目前，Lisamer 居住在上海的新亚酒店（New Asia Hotel），据报他已告知酒店管理层，将于一月间某时前往东京。

经查，未发现其使用 LESONER 或 LESONAR 姓名的任何情况，亦不知 LESONER 与 LISAMER 是否确为同一人。

（批注：C. G. 1/9）

J. Killingback
副警务处长（D. P. S.）

特务科科长（D. C. ( Special Branch )）。
